content.comment_body: I assemble systems using [product_name] and [product_name] operator devices, with most operator panels having [version_no]. Almost all known issues have been fixed by updating the firmware to [version_no] ([version_no]), except for a recurring problem with the function keys on the operator panel. After about 50 days, these keys stop responding; briefly disconnecting and reconnecting power restores them for another 50 days. This issue is present only on certain operator panel versions; others do not exhibit this behavior. Technical support responded that this is not a recognized issue. Has anyone else experienced this situation? Regards, [user_name]

I discovered that [user_name] reported the same function key issue in the German-language forum: "[article_no] - cursor keys fail during operation". I am currently testing a new operator panel ([article_no]) and will know in about 50 days if this problem persists with the latest hardware. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users describe a periodic malfunction where operator panel function keys stop responding after roughly 50 days of use. A power cycle temporarily resolves the issue, which specifically impacts certain hardware versions. Firmware upgrades have addressed other issues but not this one. The problem affects long-term reliability and user confidence.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the operator panel's function keys to consistently operate throughout extended use, without requiring periodic manual resets or troubleshooting.
